title: Inventory
author: Odessa Kiln, Kiln & Co. Salvage
pages: Sold: 12 coils to a buyer from out of state, no names. Kept:
29 coils, 6 clear lenses, and a crate of crystal shards that grow back if you leave them in the dark. Rudy has been turning coils into hand-held guns in the foundry. He calls the little one a Spark.
It throws a bolt that cooks a fence post. I told him to stop. I also told him to make me one.
